item.title: How to Create Function in Oracle SQL
item.description: Learn how to create a function in Oracle using the CREATE FUNCTION statement. This tutorial includes syntax, features, and examples using the JustLee book database. Summary of create function in Oracle: A function in Oracle is a stored program that can accept input parameters and return a value or multiple values. In this tutorial, we will learn how to create a function in Oracle using the CREATE FUNCTION statement. We will also explore the syntax and features of the create function statement, as well as provide examples using the JustLee book database.
